integrity: The proof first obtains the minimum size from the half-order lower bound and explicit support/leaf constructions. It then proves that every minimum set chooses exactly one vertex from each support-leaf pair and that the set of omitted supports has no edge to its complement, giving a bijection with unions of connected components. A standalone exhaustive checker independently tests all labeled base graphs through order five.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the ordinary corona H circle K_1 with one new leaf attached to every base vertex.
Does not enumerate nonminimum super dominating sets or determine a full generating polynomial.
Does not cover ordinary coronas H circle F with |V(F)| greater than one or neighborhood coronas.
Exhaustive computation over all labeled base graphs of order at most five is corroborative only; the arbitrary-order theorem follows from the proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed prior enumeration.
title: Minimum super dominating sets of one-leaf coronas
